capture_timing: before any C6-A2 relevance outcome (A2 never executed)

pre_capture_preregistration.no_relevance_rule: Gold relevance, evidence IDs, answer requirements, and all retrieval metrics are never inspected; candidate IDs/ranks/scores are retrieval outputs and are never joined with relevance labels
pre_capture_preregistration.no_replacement_after_results_rule: cohort IDs are frozen before any retrieval output; a failed frozen case may only be retried/resumed as itself, never replaced

current_plan_capture_pool.definition: the 46 formal-English cases with faithful current C2 prompt-3.7.0 RetrievalPlans (C6-A1R1 audit; the 13 current-plan-unavailable cases are excluded; g018 is never reconstructed)

core_capture_cohort.selection_rule: unchanged C6-A1 preregistered algorithm: within-intent case-ID ascending, fixed repository intent-cycle round-robin, maximum 30, source population = CURRENT_PLAN_CAPTURE_POOL

semantic_structural_activation.method: pure build_semantic_query(question, plan) + DenseQueryBundle.from_semantic_query; SEMANTIC_VIEW_ACTIVE iff SemanticQuery.text != raw question; no model, no retrieval, no Gold

semantic_supplement_cohort.rule: minimum deterministic supplement from pool-minus-core to reach >=8 semantic-active cases and >=2 intents (prefer an unrepresented intent first, then the fixed intent cycle, case-ID ascending within intent; maximum 8); the pool contains only 4 semantic-active cases in total, so the reachable supplement is the single remaining active case outside core

capture_identity.compatibility_check: locked repository versions match the frozen 3.7.0 plans' resolved_versions; index identity and sparse receipt match the authoritative B-series contract

current_candidate_dataset.static_banned_field_scan: relevance / expected_evidence / required_evidence / critical_evidence / answer_requirement / gold_label / evidence_group -> none present
current_candidate_dataset.plan_provenance: frozen_plan_source per row: C4-A2R1 plan_snapshots or the C4 original faithful records; prompt_version 3.7.0
current_candidate_dataset.object_identity: object_id (production fusion semantics; no title/path/symbol/canonical-locator dedup; no C5 entity equivalence)

p0_replay_integrity.checks: deterministic repeated replay; contribution sums equal fused scores; no unavailable channel contributes; semantic_dense contributes zero under c6.current.v1; object_id dedup preserved

cost_and_isolation.write_guard: the capture connection asserted no INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE/CREATE/ALTER/DROP/UPSERT statement

semantic_a2_derivation.threshold_unchanged: >=8 cases and >=2 intents; derived mechanically without relevance
semantic_a2_derivation.note: only 4 of 46 capture-pool cases are structurally semantic-active under the frozen 3.7.0 plans (the C2 additive-delta contract rarely produces a SemanticQuery.text different from the raw question), so the substantive-evidence minimum of 8 cannot be met from current frozen coverage

final_results.result_semantics: C6-A1R2 PASS means a methodologically valid current-plan frozen candidate dataset exists for C6-A2; it does NOT mean current fusion is good, that any policy is better, that SemanticDense is beneficial, or that C6 = PASS.
final_results.resolution_of_prior_blocker: PLAN_FIDELITY_BLOCKED remains a true statement about reusing the historical 3.6.0-era streams; it is resolved for the newly captured C6-A2 cohort because current 3.7.0-plan candidate streams were newly captured under the current retrieval implementation and locked index state (the historical streams did not 'become compatible')
known_limitations: only 4 semantic-active cases exist in current frozen coverage, so semantic_a2_evidence_eligible stays false and the SemanticDense substantive decision remains EVIDENCE_INSUFFICIENT
13 formal-English cases still lack faithful current plans and are absent from the captured cohort
the capture reflects current production channel semantics at HEAD 3b450cc with the locked index state
